name: Zach Sain
brief: Misframed, repairable — the real 480×404 picture sits unscaled inside a 1280×720 export, black on every side; the performer is untouched.

source.framing: head to shin, crown tight to the top; the picture is a third of the file

fixture: zach_sain_v1_padded (controlled demo input: the clean base zach_sain_v1_demo.mp4 padded into a 1280×720 canvas — demo/derived.json; Red Curtain archive run 2026-09-20)

derived_from.file: zach_sain_v1_demo.mp4 (the clean base: Zach's demo recording, verified 2.37× on the first pass)
derived_from.injected_defect: picture_area — the 480×404 picture placed unscaled and centred inside a 1280×720 black canvas (+400+158): the padded export a phone clip gets when it is dropped on a 720p timeline
derived_from.command: ffmpeg -v error -y -i zach_sain_v1_demo.mp4 -vf pad=1280:720:400:158:black -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset medium -threads 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -movflags +faststart zach_sain_v1_padded.mp4
edits: no trim, no frame-rate change, no scaling, no mis-centering: 1800 frames, 30 fps, timestamps as the base
video re-encoded once (x264 crf 18, 1 thread); inside the picture the pixels differ from the base by the compression pass only (frame 900: mean 0.86/255, p99 5/255)
audio stream copied — decoded MD5 identical to the base (279c1861…)

recognize.note: SHA-256 of the derived source (work/midtown_zach_sain_v1_padded/source.key, the matte-cache key). This is a controlled demonstration input: the defect was injected on purpose (README, Polished demo vs evaluation corpus). The clean base is the demo's 'zach' clip; it is unchanged.

provenance: Controlled demo input derived from real performer footage by adding padding. Performer pixels and motion were not altered.
